test_notebook_launcher: test the notebook_launcher function to launch a callable in distributed processes from a notebook
test_notebook_launcher_rdzv: test the notebook_launcher with static and c10d rendezvous backends for multi-process distributed execution
test_notebook_launcher_fault_tolerant: test the notebook_launcher with max_restarts for fault-tolerant multi-process execution with retry logic
test_notebook_launcher_monitoring: test the notebook_launcher with monitor_interval to detect and fail fast on process errors
test_notebook_launcher_partialstate: test the PartialState class to initialize and query distributed process state in notebook environments
